_note: Data source names exactly as they appear in Studio's Data panel. Key = name in the generator, value = name in the user's app. Power Apps names a data source after the TABLE name inside the workbook (file name/path never matter) and adds _1 only when that name is already connected in the same app. A fresh import gets plain names, so keep these plain unless the user's Data panel shows otherwise. PLAIN_DS=1 ignores this file.
